overview: S02 is the outbound chat packet: anticheats send their own alerts through it, but they cannot see what the client renders, so none of them validate the packet's payload on the server side. The chat checks that exist in the corpus run on the INBOUND chat packet or Bukkit chat events and then talk back through S02: Grim flags blank tab-complete and impossible chat, NCP gates chat behind a captcha, Photon flags chat while sprinting or with an open inventory, and BetterAnticheat flags chat while chat is set to hidden. From the anticheat's point of view S02 is the delivery channel, not the input.

checks.name: ChatA (Grim)
checks.purpose: Flags blank or slash-only tab-complete packets, an exploit probe that accompanies chat-related client abuse.
checks.how_it_works: Pre-Via listener on the inbound tab-complete packet: if the text is exactly a slash or trims to empty, the check flags and cancels the packet. This is the chat-domain check in Grim's corpus for S02 because the outbound chat packet is the visible counterpart; the detection itself happens on the client-to-server side.
checks.detects: Tab-complete spam and blank tab-complete exploitation attempts that usually target chat or command pipelines.
checks.variations: Grim has no outbound-chat check at all; like every anticheat it only emits through S02.

checks.name: Captcha (NoCheatPlus)
checks.purpose: Gates chat behind a generated captcha: players must answer correctly before chat is accepted, with kick actions on repeated failure.
checks.how_it_works: On the inbound chat listener, a player flagged by other chat checks is sent a captcha question through the outbound chat channel (S02). The captcha check compares the player's next message to the generated code, increments tries and violation level on mismatch, re-sends the question, and executes the configured actions (up to kicking) once tries exceed the threshold.
checks.detects: Spam bots, chat flooders and automated chat abuse that cannot solve a text captcha.
checks.variations: Grim and Photon detect impossible chat states instead of gating; NCP is the only corpus anticheat that actively gates the chat channel.

checks.name: ImpossibleChat (Photon AntiCheatAddition)
checks.purpose: Flags chat messages that a vanilla client could not physically send, because the player is sprinting, sneaking, blocking, dead or had an inventory open.
checks.how_it_works: Listens to Bukkit's async chat event rather than the packet. If the user is sprinting, sneaking, blocking, dead, or has had an inventory open for over a second, the chat is impossible and the module flags with 25 violation points, cancelling the event at the configured violation level.
checks.detects: Chat-spoofing clients and macro bots that send chat while the real player state says chat is impossible.
checks.variations: BetterAnticheat HiddenChatCheck targets the HIDDEN chat-visibility setting instead of body state; both are impossible-chat detectors.

checks.name: HiddenChatCheck (BetterAnticheat)
checks.purpose: Flags chat messages sent while the player's client settings declare chat visibility as hidden.
checks.how_it_works: Tracks the chat-visibility value from inbound client settings (FULL, SYSTEM or HIDDEN). When a chat message arrives and the tracked visibility is HIDDEN, the check fails; the first occurrence is used as an initial-flag grace so settings that arrive late do not cause false positives.
checks.detects: Clients that send chat while the client settings say chat is disabled, which is impossible for a vanilla client.
checks.variations: Photon ImpossibleChat checks body state; BetterAnticheat checks the declared chat mode, the two complementary reads of the same impossibility.
